WITH plant_unavail AS (
    SELECT p.sitelabel, 
           ROUND(CAST(op.mttrh / (CAST(op.mtbfh AS numeric) + CAST(op.mttrh AS numeric)) AS numeric), 4) AS unavail
    FROM plants p
    JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN operational_metrics op ON pr.snapkey = op.snapops
    WHERE p.sitelabel = 'Solar Plant West Davidport'
),
avg_unavail AS (
    SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(op.mttrh / (CAST(op.mtbfh AS numeric) + CAST(op.mttrh AS numeric))) AS numeric), 4) AS avg_unavail
    FROM plants p
    JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN operational_metrics op ON pr.snapkey = op.snapops
    WHERE p.sitelabel != 'Solar Plant West Davidport'
      AND op.mtbfh IS NOT NULL
      AND op.mttrh IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(CAST(plant_unavail.unavail - avg_unavail.avg_unavail AS numeric), 4) AS difference
FROM plant_unavail, avg_unavail;
